countries.reasoning: Based on industry reports and production data up to 2023; China is the largest producer with multiple large fluoropolymer manufacturers confirmed by trade associations and market analysis.
USGS and chemical industry sources indicate significant PVDF production centered around major chemical producers; well documented but less than China.
Japan's chemical sector produces PVDF with several key companies and steady output per industry publications; data reliable but sometimes aggregated.
South Korean manufacturers are known producers of PVDF with exports documented; production estimates based on trade and industry data.
Germany produces specialty fluoropolymers including PVDF; production size smaller but consistent; data less granular but supported by European chemical industry reports.
